verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a self-hostable SaaS feature-flag platform, but the evidence pack never documents any setting to disable telemetry or usage tracking. Self-hosting's "full control over your data" is an adjacent deployment option, not a documented opt-out control, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
